methods.label: GitHub method (RS)
methods.method_note: Exact port of the reference RRG on the weekly group mean MSI RS Rating (default).

methods.label: MSI rank change
methods.method_note: X = 100 + (40.5 - r)/6 with r = 5-session mean MSI group rank; Y = 100 + clip((r 10 sessions ago - r now)/3, -20, 20). Quadrants: Leading/Weakening = X>=100 (rank better than 40.5, i.e. rank 1-40) with Y>=100 / <100; Improving/Lagging = X<100 with Y>=100 / <100.

methods.label: RS + rank improvement
methods.method_note: X = 100 + 10*z of the 5-session mean of each group's average stock RS Rating (z across groups, clipped to +/-3); Y = 100 + clip((R - R 10 sessions ago)/5, -20, 20) where R = 100*(N - rank)/(N - 1) from the MSI industry-group rank.

methods.label: Price
methods.method_note: Equal-weight group price index vs Nifty 500 (CNX500): X = 100 × RS / 50-day mean RS; Y = 100 × X / X 10 sessions ago.
